name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. '25' is a meaningful domain ID (chapters 01-30), not address residue; 'end' is the descriptor for an end-of-chapter handler. Name accurately reflects the verified body (Chapter 25 end handler) and is consistent with all sibling handlers in chend2.c.
purpose: Chapter 25 (火焰的審判) end-of-chapter handler: straight-line post-battle dialog/cutscene sequence that recruits 聖寇拉斯 (persisted) plus 亞奇梅吉 (runtime-only) and advances the chapter id.
logic_summary: No-branch, no-RNG handler. Shows dialog page 6, pans cursor/window to (4,0x10), reloads the chapter portrait set into FD2.TMP via fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(2), fires cutscene event 0x4B, shows dialog page 7, then fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(0x1A) for 聖寇拉斯 and fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template() (so 聖寇拉斯 is persisted). It tail-jumps (PUSH 0x1D ; JMP 0x237C8) into fd2_chapter_11_end's shared epilogue snippet: fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(0x1D) for 亞奇梅吉, then INC current_chapter_id ; RET. Because 亞奇梅吉 is initialised AFTER the save, it joins the runtime roster but is not persisted into the template chars (vendor design). All 8 CALLs (__CHK, two dialog scenes, pan, portrait reload, cutscene trigger, two char inits, save) carry no return value used by the body. 0 direct callers; dispatched via data_fd2_chapter_end_handler_table[25] (table entry @ 0x51E49 = 0x00024DF2).

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: dialog/cutscene playback, runtime char roster mutation (聖寇拉斯+亞奇梅吉), template-char save, and current_chapter_id increment.
